title: Future Plans & Certainty
completion_message: ¡Excelente inicio de nivel B1! Ahora sabes exactamente cómo hablar del futuro según el grado de planificación.

stages.title: Hablando del Futuro (Will vs Going to vs Present Continuous)

parts.visual:
WILL: Decisiones espontáneas o promesas. 
Ej: 'The phone is ringing. I WILL answer it' (Yo contestaré). 
'I WILL send you the report today' (Promesa).
parts.audio: We use WILL for spontaneous decisions or promises. For example: The phone is ringing, I will answer it. Or, I will send you the report today.

parts.visual:
GOING TO: Planes o intenciones ya decididos. 
Ej: 'We ARE GOING TO launch the product next month' (Tenemos la intención). 
PRESENT CONTINUOUS: Citas o eventos ya agendados y 100% seguros. 
Ej: 'I AM MEETING the CEO tomorrow at 9 AM' (Ya está en la agenda).
parts.audio: We use GOING TO for plans and intentions. For example: We are going to launch the product next month. We use the PRESENT CONTINUOUS for 100% confirmed arrangements in the calendar. For example: I am meeting the CEO tomorrow at 9 A.M.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del futuro según el contexto (decisión rápida, intención o cita confirmada).

questions.question:
A: We are out of coffee. 
B: Really? I ____ get some right now. (Decisión espontánea).
questions.explanation: Decisión tomada en el momento = Will (I will get some).

questions.question: I ____ to London tomorrow. I have the tickets and the hotel booked. (100% confirmado).
questions.explanation: Cita confirmada con boletos comprados = Present Continuous (I am flying).

questions.question: We ____ hire a new assistant next month. That is our plan. (Plan/Intención).
questions.explanation: Plan o intención clara pero sin fecha exacta todavía = going to.

questions.question:
A: The client is on line 1. 
B: Okay, I ____ take the call. (Decisión en el momento).
questions.explanation: Decisión espontánea para reaccionar a una situación = will.

questions.question: I promise I ____ finish the project by Friday. (Promesa).
questions.explanation: Las promesas siempre se hacen con 'will'.

questions.question: She ____ the manager at 2:00 PM today. It's on her calendar. (Cita agendada).
questions.explanation: Cita en el calendario (100% seguro) = Present Continuous (is seeing).

questions.question: They ____ open a new branch in Berlin next year. They just decided it. (Plan/Intención).
questions.explanation: Intención a futuro = are going to.

questions.question: Don't worry about the presentation. I ____ help you. (Promesa/Ofrecimiento).
questions.explanation: Ofrecer ayuda = will (I will help you).

questions.question: What time ____ the clients arriving tomorrow? (Confirmado).
questions.explanation: Present continuous en pregunta: What time ARE they arriving?

questions.question: Look at those dark clouds! It ____ rain. (Predicción con evidencia visible).
questions.explanation: Predicción basada en lo que vemos ahora (nubes oscuras) = is going to.

questions.question: I think our company ____ grow next year. (Predicción basada en opinión).
questions.explanation: Predicciones basadas en opiniones personales (I think) = will.

questions.question: We ____ a conference call tomorrow morning at 10. (Agendado).
questions.explanation: Evento en agenda = are having (Present Continuous).

questions.question: Are you ____ attend the seminar next week? (¿Tienes la intención...?).
questions.explanation: Preguntar por intenciones = Are you going to...?

questions.question:
A: I forgot to send the email! 
B: It's okay, I ____ do it for you. (Decisión rápida).
He ____ resign next month. He already wrote the letter. (Plan firme).
questions.explanation: Plan/Decisión ya tomada con anticipación = is going to.

questions.question: I ____ you an email as soon as I arrive. (Promesa).
The CEO ____ visiting our office next Monday. (Confirmado).
questions.explanation: Present continuous: The CEO is visiting...

questions.question: I don't think we ____ reach our sales target. (Opinión/Predicción).
We ____ launching the marketing campaign on Friday. (Confirmado).
questions.explanation: Present continuous para citas: We are launching...

questions.question: Hold on, I ____ open the door for you. (Decisión espontánea).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe 'will', 'going' (para going to), o la conjugación 'am/is/are' para el presente continuo.

questions.question: I promise I ____ send it today. (Promesa)
We are ____ to hire a new manager. (Intención)
I ____ flying to Paris tomorrow. (Cita confirmada)
I ____ answer the phone! (Decisión espontánea)
She ____ meeting the CEO at 2 PM. (Cita confirmada)
They ____ going to open a new branch. (Intención plural)
I think it ____ rain. (Predicción)
Don't worry, I ____ help you. (Ofrecimiento)
We ____ having a meeting tomorrow. (Confirmado plural)
He is ____ to resign. (Plan decidido)

pairs.source: Look! It is going to rain

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración que habla del futuro.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We are going to launch the product.
options: We are going to launch the product.
We go to launch the product.
questions.correct_answer: We are going to launch the product.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am meeting the CEO tomorrow.
options: I am meeting the CEO tomorrow.
I will meet the CEO tomorrow.
I am going to meet the CEO tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: I am meeting the CEO tomorrow.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I promise I will send it.
options: I promise I will send it.
I promise I am sending it.
questions.correct_answer: I promise I will send it.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: She is seeing the manager at two.
options: She is seeing the manager at two.
She will see the manager at two.
She sees the manager at two.
She is going to see the manager at two.
questions.correct_answer: She is seeing the manager at two.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: They are going to open a new branch.
options: They are going to open a new branch.
They will open a new branch.
They are opening a new branch.
We are going to open a new branch.
questions.correct_answer: They are going to open a new branch.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Don't worry, I will help you.
options: Don't worry, I will help you.
Don't worry, I am helping you.
Don't worry, I am going to help you.
I will help you don't worry.
questions.correct_answer: Don't worry, I will help you.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I think the company will grow.
options: I think the company will grow.
I think the company is growing.
I think the company is going to grow.
We think the company will grow.
questions.correct_answer: I think the company will grow.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We are having a conference call.
options: We are having a conference call.
We will have a conference call.
We are going to have a conference call.
questions.correct_answer: We are having a conference call.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Are you going to attend the seminar?
options: Are you going to attend the seminar?
Do you go to the seminar?
questions.correct_answer: Are you going to attend the seminar?
